enriched_activities.desc: Lies down in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes regularly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Stretches legs. Curls up. Turns onto back. Places arm under pillow. Remains still. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket down. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and getting ready
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Swings legs over side. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and cereal box. Closes cupboard. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Picks up spoon. Eats cereal. Drinks milk from glass. Places bowl and spoon in sink. Washes dishes. Dries hands. Puts away cereal and milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing getting ready, packing bag, and checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out clothes. Puts on clothes. Puts on shoes. Picks up bag. Opens bag. Places laptop inside. Places notebook inside. Zips bag. Picks up phone. Presses power button. Checks messages. Opens email app. Reads emails. Closes email app. Places phone in pocket. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to workplace. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Exits elevator. Walks to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at desk. Puts bag down. Turns on computer. Logs in. Checks schedule. Walks to patient room. Checks patient's vital signs. Takes notes on computer. Administers medication. Talks to patient. Walks to nurses' station. Answers phone. Writes notes. Attends meeting. Updates patient records. Talks to doctor. Ends shift.

Walks out of workplace. Walks to bus stop. Waits at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to home. Unlocks door. Enters home. Closes door. Locks door. Walks to living room.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out pan. Closes cupboard. Turns on stove. Pours oil into pan. Cuts vegetables. Places vegetables in pan. Stirs with spatula. Adds meat. Cooks. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Eats dinner. Places plate in sink. Washes dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Puts down remote. Picks up laptop. Opens laptop. Turns on laptop. Checks email. Opens social media. Scrolls through feed. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Puts down remote. Closes laptop. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry (planning ahead for off-peak electricity tariff next week)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Opens hamper. Picks up clothes. Walks to washing machine. Opens washing machine door. Places clothes inside. Closes door. Adds detergent. Presses power button. Selects cycle. Presses start button. Picks up phone. Sets alarm for off-peak hours. Places phone on counter. Opens washing machine door. Takes out clothes. Places clothes in dryer. Closes dryer door. Presses start button. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal hygiene, getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Dries body with towel. Puts on pajamas. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: reading and using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Continues reading. Puts down book. Picks up phone. Turns on phone. Opens social media. Scrolls through feed. Types message. Sends message. Closes social media. Turns off phone. Places phone on nightstand. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes regularly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still.
